source_title: A continental-scale tool for acoustic identification of European bats
chunk_text: The discussion notes that acoustic identification depends on call similarity, regional variation, data quality, and comparable parameter extraction. The authors recommend good-quality calls and close inspection of uncertain or surprising classifications. For this project, this supports cautious, evidence-based localisation and human review for uncertain cases, without transferring European species ranges to Australian clips.
caution_note: This is generic acoustic-parameter guidance from European bat identification literature. It should not be treated as an Ozimops petersi species prior.
